Text.Page:
[EN] You must help me, ! I need you...I need you to poison me!

Wait, don't go! I can explain. I need to be poisoned by a {@LinkCreature:30#140#venomous tentacullar} right away."By the titans, why?"
[ES] ¡Debes ayudarme, ! ¡Te necesito... necesito que me envenenes!

¡Espera, no te vayas! Puedo explicarlo. Necesito que un {@LinkCreature:30#140#venomous tentacullar} me envenene ahora mismo."By the titans, why?"

[EN] I have a dark secret—something truly important that I cannot reveal to anyone. Alais and the goons from the Mysterium are going to force it out of me. The right dose of {@LinkCreature:30#140#venomous tentacullar} poison acts on the brain and causes memory loss. I'd rather be forgetful than dead.
[ES] Tengo un oscuro secreto, algo realmente importante que no puedo revelar a nadie. Alais y los matones del Mysterium van a arrancármelo a la fuerza. La dosis adecuada de veneno de {@LinkCreature:30#140#venomous tentacullar} actúa sobre el cerebro y provoca amnesia. Prefiero estar desmemoriado antes que muerto.

[EN] Thank you so much, . Please, give it to me now!"Here's the poison."
[ES] Muchas gracias, . Por favor, ¡dámelo ahora!"Here's the poison."

[EN] (He chugs the poison in the bottle and then opens and closes his mouth several times, increasingly panic-stricken.)

(He points to his mouth, gesticulates wildly, and then points to another miner.)
[ES] (Se traga el frasco de veneno de un trago y luego abre y cierra la boca varias veces, cada vez más presa del pánico.)

(Señala su boca, hace gestos salvajes y luego señala a otro minero.)

[EN] I will not tell the secret even if those goons torture me. I'd rather be dead.
[ES] No revelaré el secreto ni aunque esos matones me torturen. Prefiero estar muerto.

[EN] He drank what? No wonder he can't speak.

His throat will swell to the point where he'll have trouble breathing for days. What happened?"He was trying to forget a big secret..."
[ES] ¿Qué se tomó? Con razón no puede hablar.

Su garganta se le hinchará hasta el punto de que le costará respirar durante días. ¿Qué pasó?"He was trying to forget a big secret..."

[EN] That old wives' tale about tentacullar venom? He won't forget the past, but he won't be able to give up his precious secret, either.

Somebody has to tell {@LinkCreature:230#1065$$Libinienn} about this.

We miners have an old custom, called "one-two-three-not-it," so you get to go tell Libinienn how you poisoned one of the miners.

Good luck with that, .
[ES] ¿Ese cuento de viejas sobre el veneno tentacular? No olvidará el pasado, pero tampoco podrá soltar su preciado secreto.

Alguien tiene que informarle a {@LinkCreature:230#1065$$Libinienn} sobre esto.

Los mineros tenemos una vieja costumbre llamada "uno, dos, tres, te toca", así que a ti te toca ir a decirle a Libinienn cómo envenenaste a uno de los mineros.

Buena suerte con eso, .

[EN] So you gave him tentacullar venom. And he drank it.

I...I...words fail me."I was just trying to help."
[ES] Así que le diste veneno tentacular. Y se lo tomó.

Yo... yo... me quedo sin palabras."I was just trying to help."

[EN] You'll do anything someone asks you to do, eh?

You want to know what his big secret is? He's been taking some of our finds from the dig site and hiding them for black-market confederates to pick up.

And you delayed the interrogation he so richly deserves!"I'm sorry."
[ES] Harías cualquier cosa que alguien te pida, ¿eh?

¿Quieres saber cuál es su gran secreto? Ha estado tomando algunos de nuestros hallazgos del sitio de excavación y los ha estado escondiendo para que sus cómplices del mercado negro los recojan.

¡Y retrasaste el interrogatorio que tanto se merece!"I'm sorry."

[EN] Well, you're naive, but you're no criminal.

And come to think of it, you probably punished him worse by poisoning him than I would have.

When you're an itinerant miner, getting sentenced to hard labor isn't much of a punishment.
[ES] Bueno, eres ingenuo, pero no un criminal.

Y, bien pensado, probablemente lo castigaste peor al envenenarlo de lo que lo habría hecho yo.

Cuando eres un minero itinerante, ser condenado a trabajos forzados no es gran castigo.
